description: Whose `process` a test file's listeners land on. One worker runs both files (`maxWorkers: 1`; a `workerIdleMemoryLimit` makes Jest use a worker process even so). The first file (the larger, so it runs first) adds an `exit`, an `uncaughtException` and a `SIGINT` listener, and one for an event of its own that it emits; the second reads the counts. Each test's title holds what it saw. The `exit` listener writes `exit-marker.txt`, which the run captures: it is absent when no `exit` event reached that listener before the worker ended.
